mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or quarterly GDPC1 growth fails to lead earnings surprises (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 1.5%, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 5% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher wage-driven consumption.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 70% of instances when UNRATE is below 5%, or the signal's walk-forward IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing HOUST and RSAFS signals a broadening of economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher economic growth.
failure_condition: The joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS fails to lead SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window), or SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances with positive HOUST and RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO above its 6-month moving average indicates improving supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher productivity.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds its 6-month MA, or the signal's walk-forward IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (< 0.5%) and high CPIAUCSL (> 220) signals an impending monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: The joint behavior of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window), or SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances with low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PAYEMS over 3 consecutive months indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 65% of instances with sustained PAYEMS growth, or the signal's walk-forward IC is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The difference between GDPC1 and RSAFS growth rates (GDPC1 - RSAFS) predicts the direction of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as a higher difference indicates stronger economic demand.
failure_condition: The difference between GDPC1 and RSAFS growth rates fails to predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window), or SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 45% of instances with a positive growth rate difference.
